button.name: action_cai_offer_as_tool
button.help: Let AI assistants and AI decisions run this action as a tool.

page.name: cai_decision

field.name: cai_instruction
field.placeholder: Read the ticket. If it is about an invoice, assign the Billing tag; if it is a bug report, create a task...

page.div: The AI decides which tool to call and with which arguments; the tool does the work and must enforce the business rules. Every tool acts on the record that triggered the action. Offer your own Execute Code actions with the Offer to AI button: their code receives the declared arguments in cai_args and can return data in cai_output.

xpath.li: cai_args, cai_output: arguments chosen by the AI when this action runs as an AI tool, and a dictionary to return data to the AI (Ebshel AI)
